LanguageData.ShatteredLoyalty_LosePassionsDesc: If enabled, the prisoner has a 50% chance to lose each passion when their loyalty breaks.
LanguageData.ShatteredLoyalty_GainTraitDesc: If enabled, the prisoner gains a permanent trait that makes them highly unstable.
LanguageData.ShatteredLoyalty_ApplyCatatoniaDesc: If enabled, the prisoner falls into catatonia right after their mind breaks.
LanguageData.ShatteredLoyalty_BreakSpeedDesc: Tip: Lower values (e.g. 0.5) make the interrogation longer, harder, and more realistic.
